definitions.gloss: Instagram-worthy; looks good on social media
definitions.explanation: something that is visually appealing and suitable for posting on social media to attract attention and likes

examples.japanese: SNS{映|ば}えする{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}る。
このカフェはSNS{映|ば}えするスイーツで{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This cafe is famous for its Instagram-worthy sweets.

examples.japanese: SNS{映|ば}えを{意識|いしき}したメニューが{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Menus designed for social media appeal are increasing.

notes:
MODERN JAPANESE:
SNS{映|ば}え became popular in the 2010s with the rise of Instagram and other social media platforms. It was a buzzword of 2017.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- インスタ{映|ば}え - Instagram-worthy (more specific)
- {映|ば}える - to look good (verb form)
- フォトジェニック - photogenic

USAGE:
- {料理|りょうり} - food presentation
- カフェ - cafes with aesthetic interiors
- {旅行|りょこう}{先|さき} - travel destinations
- {服装|ふくそう} - outfits

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- SNS{映|ば}えする - to be Instagram-worthy
- SNS{映|ば}えスポット - Instagram-worthy spot
- SNS{映|ば}え{狙|ねら}い - aiming for social media appeal
